prompt: Character concept lineup sheet for an epic high fantasy MMORPG: seven original playable peoples standing side by side, full body, front three-quarter view, evenly spaced, each with a distinct silhouette, standing on a stone ledge with a soft painted sky-isle background. Stylized painterly hand-painted look, heroic stylized proportions, warm golden key light, cool teal shadows. Outfits are grounded and handmade (leather, cloth, forged metal) with epic details: teal crystal accents and gold trim. From left to right: (1) Rootborn: broad stocky humanoid with bark-grained wooden skin, lichen and moss growing on shoulders and beard, carved stone pauldron, stone-headed hammer. (2) Cindrel: humanoid with dark basalt skin split by glowing orange ember cracks, cooler and darker on the hands, smith leathers and tongs, a glassblower pipe. (3) Shardkin: humanoid born of rock, pale stone skin with teal crystal growths along shoulders and spine, a glowing teal crystal heart visible through an open chest plate, jeweller loupe and pick. (4) Veiled One: very tall humanoid fully masked in a smooth ornate mask with no visible face, wrapped in layered living cloth embroidered with oath markings that shimmer, long spear. (5) Mossback: anthropomorphic tortoise-folk with a large domed shell carrying a tiny garden and small shrine on top, farmer clothes, walking staff. (6) Skerrin: lean anthropomorphic goat-folk with large curled horns, climbing harness and ropes, pickaxe, sure-footed hooves. (7) Rillfolk: sleek anthropomorphic otter-folk with glossy fur, apron and diving gear, holding a ladle and a net of glowing fish. No text, no labels.
